description: Prepare fee-safe withdrawal of an expired ve-token stake, claiming the active pool first when voted and returning pending owner/stake validation. Ends the position: the stake leaves Ve33 and returns to the owner and the vote is cleared. Only an expired stake can be withdrawn — Ve33 reverts with StakeNotExpired at any earlier time, and there is no early exit or penalty path.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

current_pool_key.description: PoolKey {token0, token1, config} or {token0, token1, fee, tick_spacing, extension, stableswap_params?}, as read from the pool or vote

name: prepare_ve33_withdraw
title: Prepare expired ve-token withdrawal
